(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((border-vals (append (map (lambda (c) (at g 0 c)) (range 0 w))
                                     (map (lambda (c) (at g (- h 1) c)) (range 0 w))
                                     (map (lambda (r) (at g r 0)) (range 0 h))
                                     (map (lambda (r) (at g r (- w 1))) (range 0 h))))
                (bg (mode-list border-vals))
                (frame-color (mode g bg))
                (objs (objects-multicolor g frame-color))
                (sub-regions (filter (lambda (o) (not (bordering? o g))) objs))
                (sub-info (map (lambda (o)
                                 (let* ((non-bg-cells (filter (lambda (p)
                                                                (!= bg
                                                                    (at g
                                                                        (fst p)
                                                                        (snd p))))
                                                              (obj-cells o)))
                                        (marker (if (null? non-bg-cells)
                                                    bg
                                                    (at g
                                                        (fst (first non-bg-cells))
                                                        (snd (first non-bg-cells))))))
                                   (list (obj-r1 o)
                                         (obj-r2 o)
                                         (obj-c1 o)
                                         (obj-c2 o)
                                         marker)))
                               sub-regions))
                (assign-row-idx (lambda (sub)
                                  (let* ((sr1 (nth sub 0))
                                         (sorted-rows (sort-by (unique (map (lambda (s)
                                                                              (nth s 0))
                                                                            sub-info))
                                                               (lambda (x) x))))
                                    (count-if (lambda (r) (< r sr1)) sorted-rows))))
                (assign-col-idx (lambda (sub)
                                  (let* ((sc1 (nth sub 2))
                                         (sorted-cols (sort-by (unique (map (lambda (s)
                                                                              (nth s 2))
                                                                            sub-info))
                                                               (lambda (x) x))))
                                    (count-if (lambda (c) (< c sc1)) sorted-cols))))
                (num-rows (length (unique (map (lambda (s) (nth s 0)) sub-info))))
                (num-cols (length (unique (map (lambda (s) (nth s 2)) sub-info)))))
           (build-grid num-rows
                       num-cols
                       (r c)
                       (let ((matching (filter (lambda (s)
                                                 (and
                                                   (= r (assign-row-idx s))
                                                   (= c (assign-col-idx s))))
                                               sub-info)))
                         (if (null? matching) bg (nth (first matching) 4)))))))
